title: Auto Loans: the checking relationship discount and how discounts stack
content:
# Auto Loans: the checking relationship discount and how discounts stack

This policy of the Auto Loans product category at PCB governs the checking relationship discount on an auto loan's APR and how it combines with the autopay discount. It applies when a loan funds and whenever autopay is enrolled or cancelled. Each product uses its own autopay discount, relationship discount, discount cap, APR floor and list of qualifying checking tiers.

## Clauses in force

1. **Grant at funding.** The relationship discount of the product is granted at funding when the borrower holds, on the funding date, an active checking account of one of the product's qualifying checking tiers. This is judged from PCB's checking records for the borrower (tier and status), matched by the customer reference.
2. **Fixed for life.** Once granted, the relationship discount is fixed for the life of the loan. It is not added later if the qualifying account is opened after funding, and it is not removed if the qualifying account later closes.
3. **Stacking.** The autopay discount and the relationship discount stack by simple addition, up to the product's discount cap and never below the product's APR floor. Any part of a discount cut off by the cap or the floor is lost, not carried over.
4. **Independence from autopay.** The relationship discount is unaffected by autopay changes.

## Retired clauses (no longer in force)

The following two clauses of this policy, which stood between clauses 3 and 4 above, are **no longer in force**. Each has been superseded by the current basis for cancelling or re-enrolling in autopay and must not be applied:

- "When autopay is cancelled and the product removes the autopay discount on cancellation, the APR rises by the autopay discount actually applied"
- "and re-enrolling later restores it"

## Positive and negative cases (hypothetical borrowers)

| Borrower's checking position | Relationship discount at funding? |
|---|---|
| Active checking account of a qualifying tier held on the funding date | granted |
| Qualifying account opened one month after funding, none held on the funding date | not added later |
| Qualifying account held on the funding date, closed a year later | granted at funding and kept |

## Basis Q&A

**If the cap or the floor cut off part of a discount at funding, is the unused part saved for later?** No. The part cut off is lost, not carried over.

**Does cancelling or re-enrolling autopay touch the relationship discount?** No. The relationship discount is unaffected by autopay changes.

superseded_clauses: When autopay is cancelled and autopay_discount_removed_on_cancel is true, the APR rises by the autopay discount actually applied
